rows.grounds: bahuvrihi compound describing one whose movement is unhindered
refers to the person described in the preceding verse
denotes uncertainty about the stated outcome

items.question: What certainty is affirmed about the unobstructed progress of that person?
premises: That person acts in the manner described previously.
Unobstructed movement arises for that person.
The stated outcome is presented as certain.
items.inference: Therefore that person attains unobstructed movement without any doubt.
items.plain_english: His movement becomes unobstructed; of this there is no doubt.
